senses.gloss:
एक एक, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 5. इ;
perhaps fr. the pronom. base ए contained in एतद्),
one, alone, solitary, single, happening only once; the
same, one and the same, identical; single of its kind,
unique, singular, chief, pre-eminent, excellent; one
of two or many [cf. एक-तर, एक-तम]; in later
Sanskrit used as an indefinite article; (अस्), m., N. of
a man, the son of Raja.

एक follows the declension of pronominals (see
Gram. 200, 237), and may be declined in the plural (e. g.
एके, some, several; एके — एके or एके — अपरे or एके —
अन्ये or एके — एके — अपरे or एके — अन्ये — एके — अपरे
—अपरे, some — others). Sometimes एक may be
repeated in the sense of ‘the one — the other, one — an-
other’ (e. g. एक — एक = एक — अन्य or एक — द्वितीय,
[]
one — the other), or in the sense of ‘one after another’
(e. g. एक एकः पुरुषः, one man after another). It
is often used in the middle of compounds either sub-
stantively or adverbially (e. g. पुण्यैक-कर्मा, prac-
tising only virtue; स्वर्गैक-सम्मुखी, f. look-
ing only up to the sky; कर-पादैक-हीनस्, de-
prived of one foot and one hand). In Vedic Sanskrit
it may sometimes be placed, together with न, before
a decad to lessen it by one, being then used in the
inst. or acc. fem., inst. or abl. neut. (e. g. एकया न
त्रिंशत् or एकां न त्रिंशत् = twenty-nine; एकेन
न विंशतिः or एकाद् न विंशतिः = nineteen). In
compounds and derivatives एक never appears in its
fem. form एका (e. g. एकस्याः क्षीरम्, the milk of
one female, is compounded into एक-क्षीरम् not
एका-क्षीरम्); [cf. Lith. ni-ékas, ‘no:’ Hib. each,
‘any;’ neach, ‘any one, one, some one, he;’ neach-
tar, ‘neither;’ neachdarach, ‘neutral:’ Gr. ἑκάτερος
ἕκα-τος Lat. œquus, c-ocles fr. êc-ocles:
Goth. ha in compounds, as haihs, Them. haiha,
ha-iha, ‘one-eyed;’ ha-nfs, Them. ha-nfa, ‘one-
handed;’ halts, Them. ha-lta, ‘lame;’ ha-lbs,
Them. ha-lba, ‘half.’]
—एक-ऋक्थिन्, &c.; see
एक-रिक्थिन्, &c.
—एक-कपाल, अस्, आ, अम्, con-
sisting of one cup, contained in one cup.
—एक-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, doing only one thing; (अस्,
आ, अम्), one-handed, one-rayed.
—एक-कर्म-
कारक, अस्, आ, अम्, doing the same thing, of
the same profession.
—एक-कार्य, अम्, n. sole
business, the same business or work; (अस्, आ, अम्),
performing the same work, answering the same end.
—एक-काल, अस्, m. one time, the same time; (अम्),
ind. at one time, only once; (ए), ind. at the same
time, at once.
—एककाल-भोजन, अम्, n. eating
but one meal in any given time.
—एककालिक, अस्,
आ, अम्, happening only once; happening once a day.
—एककालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, contemporary, coeval,
simultaneous.
—एक-कुण्डल, अस्, m. an epithet of
Kuvera; of Balabhadra; and of Śeṣa, the king of
the Nāgas.
—एक-कुष्ठ, अम्, n. a kind of leprosy,
ichthyosis.
—एक-क्षीर, अम्, n. the milk of one
(nurse &c.).
—एक-गुरु, उस्, or एक-गुरुक, अस्,
m. a spiritual brother, pupil of the same pre-
ceptor; having the same preceptor.
—एक-ग्राम,
अस्, m. the same village.
—एकग्रामीण or एक-
ग्रामीय, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabiting the same village.
—एक-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having only one wheel;
passed over by the wheel (of the carriage) of
only one (king), i. e. governed by only one king;
(अस्), m., N. of a Dānava; (आ), f., N. of a town of
the Kīcakas.
—एकचक्रवर्ति-ता, f. state of being
sole master of the whole earth.
—एकचक्र-वर्तिन्,
ई, m. sole master of the whole earth.
—एकचत्वा-
रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the forty-first.
—एक-चत्वारिंशत्,
त्, f. forty-one.
—एक-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, wander-
ing or living alone, not living in company, segregari-
ous, solitary, alone; having one follower; going
together or at the same time; gregarious; (अस्), m.
a rhinoceros.
—एक-चरण, अस्, आ, अम्, having only
one foot; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a fabulous race.
—एक-
चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, living alone, not in society; going
alone or with one follower only; (ई), m. a Pratyeka-
buddha; a follower of Buddha; (इणी), f. a loyal wife.
—एक-चित्त, अम्, n. fixedness of thought on one
object; one and the same thought, unanimity; (अस्,
आ, अम्), thinking of one thing only, intent upon,
absorbed in (e. g. तद्-एकचित्ता, f. thinking only of
him); having the same thought, of one mind,
agreeing, concurring.
—एकचित्त-ता, f. fixedness of
mind, agreement, unanimity.
—एकचित्ती-भूय, ind.
having become unanimous.
—एक-चिन्तन, अम्, n.
thinking of only one thing.
—एक-चूर्णि, इस्, m., N.
of an author.
—एक-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, of one mind,
unanimous.
—एक-चोदन, अम्, n. mentioning in the
singular number; (अस्, आ, अम्), resting upon one rule.
—एक-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम्, having only shadow,
quite dark.
—एक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. born alone or
single, produced alone; growing alone (said of a
tree); alone of its kind; of one kind, unchanging.
—एक-जन्मन्, आ, m. a king, a sovereign (whose
birth is pre-eminent); once-born, a Śūdra (opposed
[]
to द्वि-जन्मन्, ‘twice-born’).
—एक-जात, अस्, आ,
अम्, of one parentage, born of the same parents.
—एक-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, once-born; belonging to the
same family or kind, of the same caste; (इस्), m. a
Śūdra.
—एकजाति-प्रतिबद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound
only to one birth, not born again.
—एक-जातीय, अस्,
आ, अम्, belonging to the same family or kind; of the
same kind.
—एक-ज्या, f. the cord of an arc; sine of
30° or of the radius.
—एक-ज्योतिस्, इस्, m. an epithet
of Śiva.
—एक-तम, अस्, आ, अत्, one of many; one
of two; one (used sometimes as an indefinite article).
—एक-तर, अस्, आ, अम् (neut. अम् not अत् by Pā-
ṇini VII. 1, 26), one of two, either, other, different;
one of many; [Gr. ἑκάτερος Hib. n'-eachtar,
‘neither of two.’]
—एक-ता, f. oneness, unity, union,
coincidence, identity.
—एक-तान, अस्, आ, अम्, directed
to one object only, having the mind fixed on one
object only, closely attentive; (अस्), m. attention fixed
on only one object; musical harmony, (? a various
reading for the next.)
—एक-ताल, अस्, m. harmony,
unison, the accurate adjustment of song, dance, and
instrumental music; (ई), f. an instrument for beating
time, any instrument having but one note.
—एक-
तीर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bathing in the same holy water, in-
habiting the same hermitage; (ई), m. an associate in
religious offices or objects, a spiritual brother.
—एक-
तेजन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having one shaft (as an ar-
row).
—एकत्रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirty-first.
—एक-
त्रिंशत्, त्, f. thirty-one.
—एक-त्रिक, अस्, m., N.
of a ceremony.
—एक-त्व, अम्, n. oneness, unity,
union, coincidence, identity; (in gram.) the singular
number.
—एक-दंष्ट्र, अस्, m. single-toothed or
tusked; a N. of Gaṇeśa, as having one tusk, the
fellow-tusk being broken off in a scuffle by Kārtti-
keya, or according to another legend by Paraśu-rāma.
—एक-दण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having only one stick;
designation of a class of beggars; [cf. त्रि-दण्डिन्.]
—एक-दन्त, अस्, m. a N. of Gaṇeśa; [cf. एक-
दंष्ट्र.]
—एक-दिश्, क्, f. the same region.
—एक-
दुःख-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, sympathizing, having the
same joys and sorrows.
—एक-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, one-
eyed; (क्), m. a crow (as having excellent sight); an
epithet of Śiva (as having one eye in his forehead).
—एक-दृश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, alone worthy of being
beheld, the sole object of vision.
—एक-दृष्टि,
इस्, f. gaze fixed upon one object.
—एक-देवत or
एक-देवत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted or offered to one
deity; directed to one deity.
—एक-देश, अस्, m.
one spot; a part, a portion or division of a whole;
(एन), inst. partly; (अस्, आ, अम्), occupying the
same place.
—एकदेश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated in
the same region.
—एकदेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, consisting
of parts or portions, divided into parts (as a whole).
—एक-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, having only one body,
single-bodied, consisting of only one individual;
elegantly formed; (अस्), m. the planet Mercury.
—एक-द्यू, ऊस्, m., N. of a son of Nodhas (men-
tioned Ṛg-veda VIII. 69, 6. Anukram.).
—एक-
धन, अम्, n. an excellent gift, an honorific offer-
ing; (अस्), m. a kind of jug with which water is
taken up at certain religious ceremonies; (आस्), f. pl.
(scil. आपः) the water taken up by means of these
vessels.
—एकधन-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. taking or ob-
taining the vessels of water called Ekadhana; obtain-
ing an honorific offering.
—एकधनिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
Ved. carrying the vessels called Ekadhana.
—एक-
धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having the same properties, of
the same kind, professing the same religion.
—एक-
धुर्, ऊर्, f. a particular load or conveyance (?).
—एक-धुर or एकधुरा-वह or एकधुरीण,
अस्, आ, अम्, fit for but one kind of labour, or for only
one yoke; cattle for special burden.
—एक-नक्ष-
त्र, अम्, n. a lunar mansion consisting of only one
star.
—एक-नट, अस्, m. the principal actor in a
drama, the manager, who recites the prologue.
—एकनवत, अस्, ई, अम्, the ninety-first.
—एक-
नवति, इस्, f. ninety-one.
—एकनवति-तम, अस्,
ई, अम्, the ninety-first.
—एक-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्,
having one master; (अस्), m. sole master or lord;
N. of a copyist.
—एक-नायक, अस्, m. an epithet
of Śiva.
—एक-निश्चय, अस्, m. general agreement
[]
or conclusion; (अस्, आ, अम्), having come to the
same conclusion or resolution, having the same aim.
—एक-निष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, intently fixed on one
object.
—एक-नीड, अस्, आ, अम्, having only one
seat; having a common home.
—एक-नेत्र, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva (‘one-eyed’).
—एक-नेमि, इस्, इस्,
इ, Ved. having one circumference.
—एक-पक्ष,
अस्, आ, अम्, of the same side or party, an associate, a
firm partisan; partial, taking one view only; (अस्),
m. one side; (ए), ind. in one point of view.
—एक-
पञ्चाश, अस्, ई, अम्, the fifty-first.
—एक-पञ्चाशत्,
त्, f. fifty-one.
—एकपञ्चाशत्-तम, अस्, ई, अम्, the
fifty-first.
—एक-पतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same
husband.
—एक-पत्त्रिका, f. the plant Ocimum Gra-
tissimum.
—एक-पत्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, having only one
wife.
—एक-पत्नी, f. only one wife; the wife of one
man, a faithful wife, one devoted to her husband;
the wife of a man who has no other wives; the wife
of the same man.
—एक-पद् or एक-पाद्, पात्,
पदी, पत्, having only one foot, limping, lame, in-
complete; (पात्), m. an epithet of Śiva or of Viṣṇu;
N. of a Dānava; (पदी), f. a foot-path; a path, a
way, a road, (अज एकपाद्, त्, m., Ved. ‘the one-
footed driver,’ probably a deity presiding over storms;
according to the commentator a N. of the sun.)
—एक-पद, अम्, n. only one step; a simple word,
a simple nominal formation; present time, same
time; (ए), ind. at the same moment, at once, sud-
denly; (अस्, आ, अम्), having only one foot; consisting
of a single word, named with a single word; (अस्),
m. a kind of coitus; (आ), f. (scil. ऋच्) a verse con-
sisting of only one Pāda or quarter-stanza; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of a fabulous race.
—एकपद-वत्, ind. like
one word.
—एकपद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing in
the same word.
—एक-पदि, ind. upon one foot,
with one foot.
—एक-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. deciding
by one (mark of the dice), an epithet of the dice in
which one is decisive or of pre-eminent importance.
—एक-परि, ind. one over or under, a term at dice.
—एक-पर्णा, f., N. of a younger sister of Durgā
and wife of Asita-Devala; an epithet of Durgā.
—एक-पर्वतक, अस्, m. the same mountain, or
N. of a certain mountain.
—एक-पलाश, अस्, m. a
single Butea Frondosa.
—एक-पाटला, f., N. of a
younger sister of Durgā and wife of Jaigīṣavya; an
epithet of Durgā.
—एक-पाण, अस्, m. a single wager
or stake.
—एक-पात, अस्, आ, अम्, happening at once,
sudden, rapid, coming suddenly.
—एक-पातिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, standing alone or solitary, independant; (इनी), f.
(scil. ऋच्) a verse to be taken by itself or regarded
independently of the hymn to which it belongs.
—एक-पाद, अस्, m. one foot; one and the same
Pāda; (अस्, आ, अम्), having only one foot; standing
on one foot, using only one foot; (आस्), m. pl., N.
of a fabulous race.
—एक-पादिका, f. title of the
second book of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.
—एक-
पादुक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a fabulous race (‘wearing
only one shoe’).
—एक-पिङ्ग or एक-पिङ्गल, अस्,
m. an epithet of Kuvera (‘having a yellow mark in
the place of one of his eyes’).
—एक-पिण्ड, अस्, आ,
अम्, related, near of kin, united by the offering of
the funeral cake.
—एकपिण्ड-ता, f. or एकपिण्ड-
त्व, अम्, n. connection by the funeral cake, con-
sanguinity.
—एक-पुत्र, अस्, m. having only one
son.
—एक-पुरुष, अस्, m. the one supreme spirit;
(अस्, आ, अम्), consisting of only one man.
—एक-
पुष्पा, f., N. of a plant.
—एक-पृथक्त्व, अम्,
n. unity and distinctness.
—एक-प्रकार, अस्, आ, अम्,
of the same kind.
—एक-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, singu-
larly like, pre-eminently similar.
—एक-प्रभुत्व,
अम्, n. the sovereignty of one, monarchy.
—एक-
प्रयत्न, अस्, m. one effort (of the voice).
—एक-
प्रहारिक, अस्, आ, अम्, killed by one blow.
—एक-
प्राण-योग, अस्, m. union in one breath.
—एक-फल,
अस्, आ, अम्, having one or a principal result or object;
(आ), f., N. of a plant.
—एक-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, having
only one thought; (इस्), m., N. of a frog in the
Pañca-tantra.
—१. एक-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, serving
one and the same master; worshipping one deity.
 — 2. एक-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, eating together; (अम्),
n. eating but one meal (a day).
—एकभक्त-व्रत,
[]
अम्, n. eating but once a day as a religious obligation.
 — 1. एक-भक्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, of one faith, believing in
one deity.
—२. एक-भक्ति, इस्, f. eating but one meal
(a day).
—एक-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same
nature; of a simple or single nature or temperament;
(अस्), m. becoming one, oneness, agreement.
—एक-
भुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, eating but one meal (a day &c.);
eating together.
—एक-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being one,
undivided; not distracted, closely attentive.
—एक-
भोजन, अम्, n. eating one meal a day; eating in
common, feeding together.
—एक-मति, इस्, f. the
mind fixed upon one object; (इस्, इस्, इ), unanimous.
—एक-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, fixing the mind upon
one object, having only one thought, attentive;
unanimous.
—एक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of
one.
—एक-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, of one syllabic instant.
—एक-मुख, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, having the face
directed towards one spot, having the same aim; hav-
ing one chief or head, having one overseer.
—एक-
मूर्धन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having the face directed to
one spot, directed towards the same aim.
—एक-
मूला, f. the plants Linum Usitatissimum and Desmo-
dium (Hedysarum) Gangeticum.
—एक-यकार, अस्,
आ, अम्, containing only one य्.
—एक-यष्टि, इस्, f.
a single string of pearls.
—एक-यष्टिका, f. a single
string of flowers, pearls, &c.
—एक-यावन्, आ, m.,
N. of a man.
—एक-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of the same

एष्˚), f., N. of a medicinal plant.
—एकोक्ति (एक-उक्˚),
इस्, f. a single expression, a single word.
—एकोत्तर
(एक-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, greater or more by one, in-
creasing by one.
—एकोत्तरिका, f. title of the fourth
Āgama of the Buddhists.
—एकोदक (एक-उद्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, connected (as relatives) by the offering of
funereal oblations of water to the same deceased an-
cestor.
—एकोदात्त (एक-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
one Udātta accent.
—एकोद्दिष्ट (एक-उद्˚), अम्, n.
(scil. श्राद्ध) the Śrāddha or funeral rite performed
for one definite individual deceased, not including
other ancestors.
—एकोन (एक-ऊन), अस्, आ, अम्, less
by one, minus one; (used in composition with विं-
शति and the following decads, e. g. एकोनविंशति =
nineteen.)
—एकोशिका, f. the plant Cissampelos Hexan-

—एकौघ-भूत (एक-ओघ-भ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
collected into one mass, heaped or crowded together.
एकक, अस्, आ, अम्, single, alone, solitary.

एकत, अस्, m., N. of a deity [cf. द्वित and त्रित],
one of the seven Dharmarājartvijas; N. of a Brāhman.

एकतस्, ind. from one side, on one side, on one
part; singly, one by one; used sometimes as an abl.
c. of एक (e. g. एकतो ऽपि पदात्, ‘after the same
word’); एकतस् — एकतस्, on the one hand — on the
other hand, on the one side — on the other side, here
 — there.
—एकतो-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, having teeth on
only one side.

एकत्र, ind. in one place, on one spot, in close
connection; in a combined manner, together; used
sometimes as a loc. c. of एक (e. g. एकत्र करे, ‘on
one hand’); एकत्र — अपरत्र or एकत्र — अन्यस्-
मिन्, on the one side — on the other side, here — there.

एकदा, ind. at the same time, at once; once,
sometimes; once on a time, one day; at one time.

एकधा, ind. simply, singly; in one way, to-
gether; at once, once.
एकल, अस्, आ, अम्, alone, solitary.
एकशस्, ind. one by one, singly.

एकाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. एक and rt. अञ्च्?), alone,
solitary.
एकान्त, एकैक, &c. See under एक above.
एक-ताल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a single palm tree.
